text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Daiichi Ruby—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby's gaze was fixed on a crane game
filled with plushies modeled after Umamusume.
choice_data_list: They're called "Paka-Petits," and they're super popular.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby stared intently at the Paka Petit.
Perhaps she found it curious and interesting.
In that case—
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
